name: approval_audit_log
query:
SELECT
  -- One row per approval decision, from the two places this app records one:
  -- a Sales Return Request decision and a manager's credit-limit override.
  'Sales Return Request' AS `kind`,
  r.name AS `document`,
  r.customer AS `party`,
  r.approval_status AS `decision`,
  r.approved_by AS `approved_by`,
  r.approved_at AS `approved_at`,
  r.reason AS `note`
FROM `tabSales Return Request` r
WHERE r.approved_at IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Credit Limit Override' AS `kind`,
  cs.name AS `document`,
  cs.customer AS `party`,
  'Override' AS `decision`,
  cs.override_by AS `approved_by`,
  cs.override_date AS `approved_at`,
  cs.override_reason AS `note`
FROM `tabCredit Score` cs
WHERE cs.manual_override = 1 AND cs.override_date IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY `approved_at` DESC
